units.source_text: 源氏公子常被皇上宣召，不离左右，因此无暇去妻子家里。

en.t: Prince Genji was often summoned by the Emperor and kept constantly at his side, so he had no time to visit his wife's house.

units.source_text: 他心中一味认为藤壶女御的美貌盖世无双。

en.t: In his heart, he thought only that Lady Fujitsubo's beauty was without equal in the world.

units.source_text: 他想：“我能和这样的一个人结婚才好。

en.t: He thought, "If only I could marry someone like her.

units.source_text: 这真是世间少有的美人啊！”

en.t: She truly is a beauty rarely seen in this world!"

units.source_text: 葵姬原也是左大臣的掌上明珠，而且娇艳可爱，但与源氏公子性情总不投合。

en.t: Lady Aoi was also the Left Minister's cherished daughter, and she was graceful and lovely, but her temperament never suited Prince Genji's.

units.source_text: 少年人是专心一志的，源氏公子这秘密的恋爱真是苦不堪言。

en.t: Young people are single-minded, and Prince Genji's secret love was truly unbearably painful.

units.source_text: 加冠成人之后，不能再像儿童时代那样穿帘入幕，

en.t: After his coming-of-age ceremony, he could no longer pass behind the curtains as he had when he was a child,

units.source_text: 只能在作乐之时，隔帘吹笛，和着帘内的琴声，借以传达恋慕之情。

en.t: and could only, when music was being played, blow his flute from beyond the curtain, joining the koto within, and use it to convey his longing.

units.source_text: 有时隐约听到帘内藤壶妃子的娇声，聊觉慰情。

en.t: At times he faintly heard Lady Fujitsubo's lovely voice from behind the curtain, and that gave him a little comfort.

units.source_text: 因此源氏公子一味喜欢住在宫中。

en.t: For this reason, Prince Genji cared only to stay in the palace.

units.source_text: 大约在宫中住了五六日，到左大臣邸宅住两三日，断断续续，不即不离。

en.t: He would generally spend five or six days in the palace and two or three days at the Left Minister's residence, coming and going irregularly, neither close nor completely distant.

units.source_text: 左大臣呢，顾念他年纪还小，未免任性，并不见罪，还是真心地怜爱他。

en.t: As for the Left Minister, considering that Genji was still young and inevitably willful, he did not blame him, but continued to love him sincerely.

units.source_text: 源氏公子身边和葵姬身边的侍女，都选用世间少有的美人；

en.t: The ladies-in-waiting chosen for both Prince Genji and Lady Aoi were all beauties rarely found in the world;

units.source_text: 又常常举行公子所心爱的游艺，千方百计地逗引他的欢心。

en.t: and the household often held the amusements the prince loved, trying every possible way to win his favor.
